Essential Accounting Consultants

Who We Are

Essential Accounting Consultants is a full-service accounting firm with offices in Cleveland, Ohio, and Dominican Republic. We specialize in accounting, business management, and  taxes of financial statements.

Mission & Vision

Our purpose expands beyond bookkeeping. We help entrepreneurs nurture their financial future. Everyone should have full control of their finances. Our vision is giving people the tools of financial mastery so they can stay on top of their finances and improve their lives.

What We Do

We take care of bookkeeping for small business owners and we do it in a way that has never been done before—by pairing real, human bookkeepers WITH ﻿Virtual Accountants. This allows our clients hassle free service while we take care of the numbers.

Solutions

Our clients benefit from the authentic rapport that develops only in time. We are a results-driven company with years of high-quality, client satisfaction, under our belts. Simply put, Essential Accounting Consultants is here for you and your business for the long haul.

Tax Services

Essential Accounting Consultants keeps up-to-date on new tax laws and legislation; we identify key tax planning opportunities that minimize both current and future tax liabilities. We provide taxation expertise to our clients throughout the year.

Our services incorporate: Individuals, Corporations, Partnerships, LLCs/LLPs, Estates, trusts & gifts, Not-for-profit organizations

Bookkeeping Services

Well-organized financial record keeping ensures that your daily business operations run efficiently. We will assist you with the day-to-day tasks associated with bookkeeping.

Business Consulting

Our goal is to make your business more profitable and to guide structure as well as actionable steps to deliver the best possible results. We provide projections, opportunities, and assess risk exposures to keep your finances thriving.

We are highly regarded, knowledgeable, and professional accounting firm that offers a full range of services to individuals and business clients. Because our accounting practice is local and online, clients benefit by receiving personalized, quality service.
